_about: Round 143: the commission board. Four orders a day in each town, named clients who want a made thing in a minimum quality. Paid a little over what a trader would give (never a buy-craft-sell loop: the pay is bounded by what the materials cost and a daily gold cap), plus standing with the matching guild (kept for you if you haven't joined), a little skill practice, and now and then a find. scripts/systems/Commissions.gd.

smithing.name: Watchman Tove
smithing.reason: The night watch is down to rusted pikes and good intentions.

smithing.name: Farmer Oska
smithing.reason: Our ploughshare cracked on a root as old as the village.

smithing.name: Mara the carter
smithing.reason: Every cart I own is held together with prayer and string.

smithing.name: Old Gunnar
smithing.reason: I'm too old to fight, but I refuse to be buried with a bad sword.

smithing.name: Bell Ashdown
smithing.reason: The lodge is two blades short, and the delvers are being polite about it.

smithing.name: Halvar the miller
smithing.reason: The millstone chisels have worn to nubs. It's flour or nothing.

alchemy.name: Pim
alchemy.reason: My master says I can't run the shop until I stock it. I have never stocked a shop.

alchemy.name: Merchant Zuri
alchemy.reason: My guards keep catching colds. A caravan of sneezing guards is not a caravan.

alchemy.name: Brother Aldous
alchemy.reason: The brothers are fasting, and some of them are cheating. A strong tonic helps.

alchemy.name: Widow Perrin
alchemy.reason: A full house, and every lodger with a different complaint.

alchemy.name: Kestrel
alchemy.reason: Three days on the road without sleep. Don't ask. Just make it.

alchemy.name: Doctor Ames
alchemy.reason: I left my own kit in the last village. Please, something sound.

medicine.name: Midwife Odrun
medicine.reason: It's going to be a long night in the lower lanes, and I'm short of everything.

medicine.name: Nurse Callis
medicine.reason: The infirmary has eleven beds and nine patients. I could use more of the good stuff.

medicine.name: Brenn the shepherd
medicine.reason: The flock has a cough and I have a conscience.

medicine.name: Sister Maud
medicine.reason: Comfort, mostly. Whatever you can spare of it.

medicine.name: Teodric
medicine.reason: She's gone down again. She'll come back hurt. I want to be ready this time.

medicine.name: Little Wren
medicine.reason: My brother fell off a roof. He's fine. He is also very loud about it.

jewelcrafting.name: Ilsa
jewelcrafting.reason: A spring wedding and the only thing missing is something worth looking at.

jewelcrafting.name: Corra
jewelcrafting.reason: My husband's shop needs a piece in the window or it's a funeral too.

jewelcrafting.name: Merchant Dune
jewelcrafting.reason: A gift for someone I need to impress. I'm paying for the impression.

jewelcrafting.name: Abbot Hale
jewelcrafting.reason: A reliquary needs something to hold. The saints are not choosy.

jewelcrafting.name: Lord Venn's steward
jewelcrafting.reason: His lordship wants a trinket. His lordship has expensive opinions.

jewelcrafting.name: Fenn
jewelcrafting.reason: My master says I have no eye. I'd like him to be wrong.
